effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC (the vault's immutable asset 0x7547…b603) to the vault through transferFrom.
The vault mints shares (satUSDC) to `onBehalf`; the number is previewDeposit(assets) at the current share price, after fee accrual, with no minimum bound.
accrueInterest first mints fee shares to the fee recipients; this sets the price but takes nothing from the signer's amount.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.31 USDC, shares are satUSDC, sent to the onBehalf address.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many satUSDC shares the receiver gets; the price comes from storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` No minShares argument. Case 0: signer receives 0.309992200264726082 satUSDC; screen shows only 'Share ticker: satUSDC'.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix. Optionally relabel 'Share ticker' to 'Receive shares in' so the signer knows shares arrive.

cases.notes: USDC out 0.31 shown exactly. satUSDC in: asset and receiver shown, amount computed by the vault and not shown.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns previewWithdraw(assets) satUSDC shares (rounded up, no maximum bound) from `onBehalf`, the signer in the normal case.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, the signer spends `onBehalf`'s share allowance by that number of shares.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 3902.289859 USDC to the receiver, with the owner whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many satUSDC shares it burns from the owner; the code computes it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` → `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 2: signer loses 3901.700176916302182002 satUSDC; no screen line states shares leave.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix for the number. Optionally change the 'Owner' label to 'Burn shares from' so the share outflow is stated.

cases.notes: USDC in exact amount and receiver shown. satUSDC burned not stated; reader guessed shares leave but not how many.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` satUSDC from `onBehalf`, the signer in the normal case (or spends onBehalf's allowance to the signer).
The vault sends previewRedeem(shares) USDC to `receiver`; the amount is computed from the share price, with no minimum bound.
formats.shown: Redeem 16378.418266048849569465 satUSDC to the receiver, with the owner; the asset that arrives is not named.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets, though the descriptor has it as a constant.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` asset = USDC (immutable 0x7547…b603). Descriptor redeem fields: 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner' only. Case 3: signer receives 16378.885091 USDC; reader: 'exact amount and token not shown'.
findings.fix: Add a field like mint has: {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, and change interpolatedIntent to "Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}".

findings.title: redeem cannot show the USDC amount received; the vault computes it and enforces no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);` No minAssets parameter.

cases.notes: Shares out shown exactly. USDC in: neither token nor amount on screen; reader guessed 'likely USDC'.

effects: The signer sends previewMint(shares) USDC (rounded up, no maximum bound) to the vault through transferFrom.
The vault mints exactly `shares` satUSDC to `onBehalf`.
formats.shown: Mint 1 satUSDC for 0x…dEaD, with 'Deposit asset: USDC' and no USDC amount.

findings.title: mint intent and sentence do not say the signer pays USDC; the 'Deposit asset' line has no amount.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: intent 'Mint', interpolatedIntent 'Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}', field 'Deposit asset' raw 'USDC'. VaultV2.enter: `safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)`. Case 1: signer pays 1 USDC; reader: 'How much USDC is taken'.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Pay USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}" and relabel the field 'Pay with (amount set by share price)'.

findings.title: mint cannot show the USDC amount taken from the signer; the vault computes it with no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);` No maxAssets parameter; only the signer's USDC allowance limits it.

cases.notes: USDC out of 1.0: asset shown as a ticker, amount not shown. Shares go to 0xdEaD (signer null), shown correctly and understood by the reader.
